The manual's section 1 requires the Windows region and language to be set to English (United States) for the software to parse its own character format. That is a strong hint the tool is a localised OEM build, and a further reason not to assume anything about the wire.

unmappedReports: The whole telemetry set is unmappable in the sense that matters: the manual describes a Windows GUI ('Real-time monitoring', 'Real Time Curve', 'Global Monitoring', a Read button showing station name, model, version and serial number) and NEVER states which values cross the wire, in what units, at what address. There is nothing to map to a MetricKind because there is nothing documented to decode.
